setup:
bash -euo pipefail -c 'runtime=/opt/koel-php; mkdir -p "$runtime/apt-state/lists/partial" "$runtime/apt-cache/archives/partial"; apt_options=(-o "Dir::State=$runtime/apt-state" -o Dir::State::status=/var/lib/dpkg/status -o "Dir::Cache=$runtime/apt-cache"); apt-get "${apt_options[@]}" update; DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get "${apt_options[@]}" install -y --download-only --no-install-recommends php-cli php-curl php-mbstring php-xml php-gd php-zip php-intl php-sqlite3 php-bcmath; for archive in "$runtime"/apt-cache/archives/*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$archive" "$runtime"; done; extension_directory=$(find "$runtime/usr/lib/php" -name pdo.so -printf "%h
" -quit); printf "extension_dir=%s
" "$extension_directory" > "$runtime/php.ini"; for extension in pdo xml dom simplexml xmlreader xmlwriter xsl curl mbstring gd zip intl sqlite3 pdo_sqlite bcmath ctype exif fileinfo iconv tokenizer phar posix sockets; do printf "extension=%s
" "$extension" >> "$runtime/php.ini"; done; php_binary=$(find "$runtime/usr/bin" -maxdepth 1 -name "php[0-9]*" -type f -print -quit); printf "#!/bin/sh
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/koel-php/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu
export PHPRC=/opt/koel-php/php.ini
exec %s "\$@"
" "$php_binary" > /usr/local/bin/php; chmod +x /usr/local/bin/php; php -v; php -m'
warmup: php -r '$key = "base64:".base64_encode(hash("sha256", getenv("APP_KEY"), true)); file_put_contents(".env", preg_replace("/^APP_KEY=.*/m", "APP_KEY=".$key, file_get_contents(".env")));' && unset APP_KEY && php artisan koel:init --no-interaction --no-assets --no-scheduler
install: php -r '$key = "base64:".base64_encode(hash("sha256", getenv("APP_KEY"), true)); file_put_contents(".env", preg_replace("/^APP_KEY=.*/m", "APP_KEY=".$key, file_get_contents(".env")));' && unset APP_KEY && php artisan koel:init --no-interaction --no-assets --no-scheduler

app.cmd: unset APP_KEY; exec php -S "0.0.0.0:$PORT" -t public server.php

web.cmd: exec node --input-type=module -e 'import { createServer } from "vite-plus"; const publicUrl = new URL(process.env.VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL); const server = await createServer({ server: { host: "0.0.0.0", port: Number(process.env.PORT), strictPort: true, origin: publicUrl.origin, cors: { origin: process.env.APP_URL }, hmr: { host: publicUrl.hostname, protocol: "wss", clientPort: 443 } } }); await server.listen(); server.printUrls();'
